title: On Discussing the matter for two evenings
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：discuss　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 discuss 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the cook ① discussed the matter for two evenings with great care, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the cook ② discusses the matter for two evenings on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ discuss the matter for two evenings at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ discussed the matter for two evenings before — a line in the menu for September 1942 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Discussing the matter for two evenings with great care, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ discuss the plan in small groups on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Discuss the plan in small groups at once and never mention it again.

By 1955 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a new guest from the next canteen ⑧ discusses the plan in small groups with great care every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the table, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ discussed the matter for two evenings again when nobody else would.

⑩ To discuss the matter for two evenings, my mother said in 1960, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, somebody discusses the matter for two evenings on the same day again and somebody must discuss the matter for two evenings with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 讨论（一般过去式 discussed the matter for two evenings：1948 年厨子头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 讨论（一般现在 discusses the matter for two evenings：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 讨论（不定式 to discuss the matter for two evenings：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 讨论（过去完成时 had discussed the matter for two evenings：1942 年九月的菜单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 讨论（动名词 discussing the matter for two evenings 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 商量（discuss the plan in small groups：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去商量分组讨论那套方案）
G. v. 商量（discuss the plan in small groups：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 讨论（后段两处：新来的客人照例 discusses the plan in small groups，而母亲又一次 discussed the matter for two evenings）

answers.why: discuss 意为“讨论”，1948 年厨子小心翼翼地讨论连着两个晚上商量这件事，那是食堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 discussed。
discuss 意为“讨论”，自那以后厨子当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 discusses。
discuss 意为“讨论”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯讨论连着两个晚上商量这件事”，此处为不定式 to discuss the matter for two evenings。
discuss 意为“讨论”，菜单里 九月 那行字说明早在 1955 年之前就有人讨论过，故用过去完成时 had discussed。
discuss 意为“讨论”，厨子说“讨论连着两个晚上商量这件事这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 discussing the matter for two evenings 作主语。
discuss 意为“商量”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去商量分组讨论那套方案”，should ever 之后用原形 discuss the plan in small groups。
discuss 意为“商量”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻商量分组讨论那套方案（discuss the plan in small groups at once），以后再也不要提起。
discuss 意为“讨论”，新来的客人每个日子都照例商量分组讨论那套方案，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 discusses。
discuss 意为“讨论”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地讨论连着两个晚上商量这件事，用一般过去式 discussed 叙述。
discuss 意为“讨论”，结尾那句是母亲 1960 年的话：要讨论连着两个晚上商量这件事，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和食堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 discuss 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1948 the cook discussed the matter for two evenings with great care, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the cook discusses the matter for two evenings on the same day whenever the canteen asks.
Discussing the matter for two evenings with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever discuss the plan in small groups on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new guest from the next canteen discusses the plan in small groups with great care every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother discussed the matter for two evenings again, and the canteen remembered that half.
